# `gen.ornament`: Ornament

Repeats a motif (studs, pyramids, beads, runes, rope, scroll filigree) along a path or around a band, raised off the surface as geometry.

- Category: gen
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(path points + motifs x motif faces)
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: ornament, trim, studs, rivets along, runes, rune band, filigree, rope trim, beading, decoration, array along curve

Ornament is described, not drawn: a `motif`, where it runs (`path` points with the `normal` out of the surface, or a `band` around an axis such as a haft or a helmet rim), and `size`, `relief` above the surface and `sink` into it. Motifs are spaced 1.5 sizes apart unless `count` or `spacing` says otherwise; `variation` loosens spacing, size and turn so the rhythm is not mechanically even (leave it at 0 for regular dwarven work). Runes are angular glyphs of raised strokes chosen by the seed; rope is twisted plies; scroll is a wave with curls. Every piece is closed. In a Model Spec the `ornament` shape kind takes the same parameters.

**Use for** rune bands on hafts and belts, studs along an edge, rope trim, beaded rims and filigree.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `band` | `BandParam \| null` | - | A ring around an axis instead of a path: `{"radius": "2cm", "axis": "y", "at": [0, 0.3, 0]}`. |
| `closed` | `boolean` | `false` | Join the path's last point back to the first. |
| `count` | `number \| null` | - | Motifs along the path; fills it at `spacing` when omitted. |
| `motif` | `MotifParam` | `"stud"` | What repeats: `stud`, `pyramid`, `bead`, `rune`, `rope` or `scroll`. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; `ornament` when omitted. |
| `normal` | `[number, number, number] \| null` | - | Out of the surface along a path (made perpendicular to it); +Y when omitted. Bands face away from their axis. |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | - | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `path` | `[Length, Length, Length][] \| null` | - | The curve to follow, as points; a 5 cm band around Y when neither `path` nor `band` is given. |
| `plies` | `number \| null` | - | Rope plies (2 to 5); 3 when omitted. |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Origin position in the parent's space. |
| `relief` | `Length \| null` | - | Height above the surface; 0.4 sizes when omitted. |
| `sink` | `Length \| null` | - | Depth sunk into the surface; 0.15 sizes when omitted. |
| `size` | `Length` | `0.01` | Motif width (rope and scroll: the band width). |
| `spacing` | `Length \| null` | - | Distance between motif centers (scroll: the wave length); 1.5 sizes when omitted. |
| `variation` | `number` | `0.0` | Random change of spacing, size and turn: 0 even (regular rhythm) to 1 loose. |

## Examples

```json
{"band":{"radius":"2cm"},"count":8,"motif":"stud","size":"8mm"}
```

Result: `created ornament (o:4) stud ornament 43.59 x 8 x 43.53 mm: 488 faces (944 tris; budget 6,000)`
